page: Microsoft Azure DC32s_v3 is a member of the DCSv3 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8370C processor with 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs operating at 2.8 GHz. The server is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core. It has no local storage, though it is Premium Storage capable, and does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data reveals strong multi-threaded performance, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 17321.0 and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression reaching 276.82 GB/sec. The processor's cryptographic capabilities are highlighted by a strong PassMark CPU encryption score of 36894.88, supported by hardware flags like AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. However, single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core score, fall into the average range. Large-scale LLM text generation is a notable bottleneck, with the 70B model text generation speed scoring in the bottom 25% at 2.73 tokens/sec.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the DC32s_v3 offers a high-density memory-to-CPU ratio suitable for memory-intensive workloads without the added cost of bundled local storage or GPU hardware. Strong performance in PassMark database operations and static web serving throughput makes this server highly suitable for relational database hosting, enterprise web serving, multi-threaded data processing, and cryptographic applications.
